Proposed tools

THE PROBLEM

Why it matters

Admin panels often give everyone full access and keep no record of who changed what.

DESIGN APPROACH

Approach

Role-based access designed from the start, with an append-only audit log. Builds on the admin-key idea in the analytics demo.

Key features

  • 01User table with roles
  • 02Permission matrix
  • 03Audit log
  • 04Bulk actions
